plugins.name: hello-tool
plugins.description: Minimal plugin: registers a `hello` tool. Use it to verify the plugin pipeline before writing real tools.

plugins.name: word-count
plugins.description: Read-only `word_count` tool that counts words/lines/characters in a workspace file by calling the built-in `read_file` via ToolsService.

plugins.name: session-ttft
plugins.description: Event listener (no tools): logs TTFT/total/tok-per-second for every model call via the `llm/metrics` event.

plugins.name: greeter-config
plugins.description: Config-driven tool: `greeter` greets the audience from plugin config — teaches the { src, config } plugin spec.

plugins.name: usage-ledger
plugins.description: Appends one JSONL line per model call (model, ttft, total, tok/s) to .switchboard/usage-ledger.jsonl — self-audit of token usage.

plugins.name: git-snapshot
plugins.description: Read-only `git_snapshot` tool: branch, short status, last 3 commits via child_process — no approval prompt because it never writes.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Two tools: `notes_add` (risky write, gated by the harness approval) and `notes_list` (read-only) over .switchboard/notes.md.
